nodes.label: Dendritic Nix flake extension skill
nodes.content: The skill explains how to add NixOS features, packages, and explicitly composed hosts in the recursive flake-parts architecture.

edges.evidence: The skill says flake.nix imports every non-underscore .nix file and ordinary files must be flake-parts modules.
The skill requires named feature exports, independently usable leaves, explicit leaf checks, and enabled fixtures where useful.
The skill directs package exports to perSystem.packages and distinguishes self' from outer self package access.
The skill requires host configuration and hardware constituents, an explicit aggregate, and mkHost construction.
